name: Line-Based Pipe Volume Generation
definition: Generates a 3D volume density field along predefined line paths using OpenSimplex noise to create pipe-like cave structures, which are later meshed via marching cubes.
summary: Line-Based Pipe Volume Generation creates 3D pipe-like cave structures by restricting OpenSimplex noise evaluation to the vicinity of parametric line segments, carving volumetric tubes rather than filling a bounding box.
